modules.name: Verified workspace foundation
modules.summary: Existing local-model tools, browser, runnable artifacts, recipes and evaluated controller adaptation. Historical evidence in edition 008.

modules.name: Existing 2D mechanics foundation
modules.summary: JBox2D gravity/collisions and fixed stepping; transforms/camera are 2D and zIndex is draw order.

modules.name: Shared experiment contracts
modules.summary: Dependencies: current foundation. Acceptance: Stable IDs/revisions, units/frames/clock, persistence, stale-edit and invalid-value rejection; original regressions retained.

modules.name: 3D adapter selection and actual viewport
modules.summary: Dependencies: P1. Acceptance: Recorded backend decision, compatible packaging/licenses, perspective selection, physical depth/collision support and shared Java state.

modules.name: Complete ramp/block mechanics lab
modules.summary: Dependencies: P2. Acceptance: Play/pause/step/reset/save/replay; analytical reference tolerances; stable contacts; actual measurements.

modules.name: Agent-controlled experiments
modules.summary: Dependencies: P3. Acceptance: Validated parameter changes, actual runs/results, independent objective checking and bounded cancellation.

modules.name: Real measurement binding
modules.summary: Dependencies: P3. Acceptance: Versioned provenance/units/mappings, measured/assumed/predicted labels and independently checked residual calculation.

modules.name: Evaluated physical experience
modules.summary: Dependencies: P4, P5. Acceptance: Tick/entity/action-linked episodes, withheld conditions, measured improvement, rejected regression and rollback.

modules.name: Target-language generation
modules.summary: Dependencies: P1. Acceptance: Separate execution boundary; typed specification/IR; two toolchains and independent equivalent-behavior checks.
